text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono's breathtaking, colossal 
running and Biko Pegasus's riveting, 
unyielding drive inspired deep, profound 
emotion in everyone watching.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Filled with deep satisfaction and 
gratitude, Hishi Akebono thanked Biko 
Pegasus with all her heart for going all 
out against her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, around that time at Tracen 
Academy, Taiki Shuttle was watching the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle seems to hold strong 
feelings regarding Hishi Akebono. Pumping 
herself up with the resolve to run right 
beside her in the next race, she dashes 
off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next target race is the "Yasuda 
Kinen." A grand stage where a new assassin 
awaits!
